attestation.immutableSource: release_sha is captured once in the deterministic immutable release ref/tag and is ancestor-reachable from main; later main advances are evaluated by dependency closure

controls.immutableSource: release-source-<sha> identity plus finalized artifact manifest; source SHA is reachable from main at identity creation
controls.featureFlag: module-specific flag remains disabled until the approved stage
controls.killSwitch: a documented per-unit switch must stop new promotion and the module fallback must remain available
controls.rollback: restore the exact previous attested Worker versions and Pages deployment through canonical publishers; migrations remain additive
controls.automaticInterruption: a stage may not advance when error, latency, journey, cohort, route-isolation or sibling-module evidence exceeds policy; after the kill switch is externally observed, the coordinator may execute only exact compensating rollback to journaled incumbents, may not upload new code, and must attest every dispatched surface
controls.stagingRollbackDrill: staging evidence is invalid until all four exact incumbents are exercised, compatible health is observed, all exact candidates are restored, and module-control remains maintenance
controls.directVersionOverrideIngress: before every pilot, canary or production mutation, the first two enabled rules in the zone-scoped custom WAF entrypoint must unconditionally block both public API hosts when either cloudflare-workers-version-overrides or cloudflare-workers-version-key is present or Cloudflare reports truncated request headers, and must unconditionally block recursively URL-decoded /insumos/health/workforce-contract path variants. The external matrix must prove plain, single-encoded, double-encoded and case-folded paths on both hosts, plus both forbidden headers and a negative control per host. No preceding skip rule and no cf.worker.upstream_zone exemption is allowed because an attacker-controlled Worker is still untrusted. Worker JavaScript and late transforms are defense-in-depth only; exact candidate proof is allowed only through protected Pages service bindings.
controls.privateCoreBootstrap: The first governed application release must consume the exact immutable run, artifact digest, deployment, version, bindings and zero-exposure evidence cataloged for skincos-ponto-core and skincos-ponto-core-staging before any candidate mutation. After a successful staging release, later staging runs may consume only a separately cataloged, source-bound, successful staging incumbent with its release artifact re-verified live; the historical bootstrap remains immutable rollback evidence. Mixed candidate config plus ancestral source, self-baselining, drifted incumbents and unreviewed service deletion are forbidden.

core-workers.killSwitch: module-control:timekeeping=maintenance or disabled for Ponto traffic
core-workers.rollback: pre-pilot attested route-isolated Ponto Core and Identity/Inventory versions through deploy-core-workers.yml
core-workers.pilotCanary: Ponto never split-deploys the shared skincos-api Worker. The private no-route skincos-ponto-core candidate is pinned to exact Timekeeping and remains at 0 percent default traffic for pilot and canary; Pages selects it only through an internal service binding for the conjunctively authorized cohort. Shared Core versions plus Finance and Inventory probes must remain unchanged. Identity/Inventory stays at 0 percent default traffic and its candidate contract is probed only through a protected internal binding.

crm-pages.rollback: pre-pilot attested Pages deployment through deploy-crm-pages.yml
crm-pages.pilotCanary: Ponto coordinator deploys the same SHA and Pages uses the PONTO_CORE private service binding. Candidate selection is conjunctive on opaque employee, Identity, Identity-login, unit and network grants before canary bucketing; public URL fetch and public version-override selection are forbidden.

escala-api.pilotCanary: blocked: Worker gradual routing and external SLO evidence are not configured

timekeeping.rollback: pre-pilot attested Timekeeping version through deploy-timekeeping.yml with additive-migration compatibility
timekeeping.pilotCanary: Ponto coordinator keeps the Timekeeping candidate at 0 percent default traffic for pilot and canary, authorizes only the conjunctive opaque employee, Identity, Identity-login, unit and network cohort, and requires the external authenticated CONSULTOR SLO workflow before advancement

meta-ads-report.pilotCanary: blocked: job-level canary and external ingestion journey evidence are not configured
